description: radicle-spike's rules for fabric-pr arm. boundary.paths: the spike installs, configures and confines a network daemon (a Radicle seed) on a shared host, so its boundary is what installs, starts and fences it (scripts/), its configuration, unit and the release signers it trusts (seed/), the tests that prove the fences (tests/), CI (.github/), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, credential, token, key, auth, signer, trust, seed, unit, service, sudo). boundary.exempt is dropped first: Markdown, which is the findings' and the records' prose, and .agent-fabric/. No classes. waiver_role is null: only the owner waives the boundary.
